doc:
Adapt native Pump observations to the preserved 2CQ frozen scorer.

This adapter is intentionally fail-closed.  It does not substitute first-seen
time for launch time, current state for launch state, or wallet identity for
creator identity.  It emits exact-score signals and same-period controls only
when the complete causal feature lineage is present.
Correlate the final AllenHark repair census without reading outcomes.
Correlate a frozen canonical Pump census with AllenHark proxy instrumentation.
Exact fail-closed resolver for unresolved Pump-family evidence.

Descriptive, outcome-blind KEFI route clue audit.

This report is exploratory only.  It describes the sealed KEFI route event
inventory and execution context; it does not search thresholds, select a
policy, freeze a rule, or read the prospective validation lane.
Summarize a sealed Pump-curve surface for hypothesis generation only.

Audit native timing joins and native-vs-finalized Pump state separately.

This is a read-only gate.  It deliberately does not treat a native receipt
clock as proof that native reserve state was available.  The two evidence
planes are audited independently:

* native receipt/finalized wallet joins: signature, slot, and receive-clock
  completeness;
* native replay/finalized state rows: exact pre/post virtual-reserve parity.

The gate never submits, selects, freezes, or promotes a strategy.  It also
does not overwrite the older parity reports; callers provide a new output
path for this version.

Resolve executor/CPI action identity without fabricating native economics.

The AllenHark tape proves that the outer executor invokes Pump and preserves
the raw executor instruction bytes.  This audit joins those candidates to the
preserved finalized transaction logs and inner instruction topology.  It
admits BUY_V3/SELL_V3 only when exactly one Pump action is present and the
candidate curve appears in the Pump inner instruction accounts.

This is an action/route gate only.  It does not create pre-receipt reserves,
fees, quotes, or PnL and therefore cannot pass the native-state economics gate
by itself.

Audit the independent strategy surface without promoting a policy.

The strategy lab is allowed to calculate exploratory surfaces at research
notionals.  This gate checks that the surface is actually the intended
read-only 1-second-delay, 0.1/0.5/1.0 SOL experiment and keeps validation
blocked until controls and native state parity exist.

Audit a preserved ARM07 cohort against the current evaluator bundle.

This is a read-only research audit.  It never edits the preserved cohort,
registry, frozen policies, or collection service.  The output is a new
audit artifact containing the current code fingerprints and an exact replay
comparison against the sealed historical economics report.
Build a read-only priority audit for the KEFI 13-arm coverage program.

Audit exact adapter availability without claiming fixture/economic coverage.

This is deliberately stricter than a path check: each declared local Python
adapter must import successfully, and each venue family must have an explicit
state in the coverage matrix. Runtime fixture parity remains a separate gate.
Audit the dedicated finalized-RPC KEFI source before economics.
Audit the isolated post-freeze observation partitions before economics.

Requirement-level completion audit for the canonical 13-arm program.

This report is deliberately allowed to remain incomplete.  It prevents a
passing registry/source check from being mistaken for a completed global
out-of-sample comparison.

Reconcile the canonical 13-arm program into one evidence-based status.

This is a reporting gate, not a selector.  It keeps raw candidate references,
exactly admitted observations, fresh economics, adapter coverage, and final
decisions separate so a no-data arm cannot become a losing-arm claim.

Reconcile the current receive-only source into a promotion-review gate.

The older source-compatibility audit describes a different candidate stream.
This gate consumes the current finalized-RPC source audit, exact materializer
audit, and fresh-cohort audit so final review cannot accidentally use stale
source metadata.
Audit the exact PumpSwap receive-only tape and its fail-closed errors.

Audit whether a fresh arm report can enter quote/live-parity paper review.

This is a readiness gate, not an execution launcher.  It keeps the paper-stage
promotion separate from the stronger deterministic-source contract required
for quote/live-parity replay.

Audit the receive-only source before canonical 13-arm ingestion.

This check is intentionally outcome-blind.  Candidate metadata is not an
observation, and a healthy stream is not equivalent to a usable scientific
cohort.  The source must provide a post-freeze sealed raw window and the
canonical arm materializer must be able to bind each row to an exact venue,
decoder, evaluator, and frozen policy.

Audit whether ARM08 is ready for a frozen-policy prospective gate.

This gate is intentionally stricter than discovery.  It does not choose a
policy.  It checks identity, causal coverage, lineage quality, independent
controls, and fresh-cohort requirements, while emitting descriptive ARM08
fingerprint clues that cannot use exit outcomes for selection.

Fail-closed gate for native route-specific causal coverage.

This is a coverage gate, not an economics evaluator.  It proves that a route
has enough native KEFI entries, native same-route controls, exact lineage, and
post-entry state marks to justify a later preregistered economics study.  It
does not select or freeze a policy and it cannot validate a strategy.
Read-only inventory of EdgeSniffer storage writers and observed growth.

Audit a non-look-ahead native Pump state replay bridge.

This bridge does not replace the strict finalized-value parity gate. It answers
the live question directly:

1. Was the selected Pump account state causally available at receipt?
2. Can the target instruction be decoded and replayed from that state using
   the native fee fields?
3. Was the finalized event's pre-state actually visible by receipt, or only
   later in the account-update stream?

The bridge is read-only. It never uses a future account update as live input,
never admits economics, and never submits a transaction.

Adjudicate native-vs-finalized Pump state mismatches without changing a gate.

The canonical parity gate intentionally asks a strict question: did the state
selected at native receipt equal the later finalized event's pre/post state?
This report answers the next question: when they differ, does the finalized
pre-state appear in the native account tape only *after* the transaction was
received?  If so, the difference is receipt/account-stream ordering lag, not a
missing causal seed and not proof that the native decoder is wrong.

This is read-only research telemetry.  It never changes the canonical parity
gate, admits economics, freezes a policy, or submits a transaction.
Audit native pre-finality Pump replay against finalized exact state.

Diagnose why native reserve rows fail finalized parity.

This report never repairs a row by importing finalized state.  It only measures
the causal seed's age and slot distance at the native receive clock, then
compares the native reserves with the preserved finalized event state.

Audit whether native Pump state was causally available before each target tx.

This is deliberately separate from exact finalized-value parity. A native
state may be valid for a live decision even when a later finalized account
update contains a different post-trade value. The audit never changes the
finalized parity gate and never admits execution.

Materialize a receive-only native timing/inclusion telemetry gate.

This consumer never submits a transaction and never modifies the source or
window tapes.  It records the timing fields that are already emitted by the
receive-only RPC collectors, keeps them separate from derived block-time
fields, and fails closed until genuine native receive and submitted-exit
telemetry exists.

The current collector's ``captured_at_utc`` is an RPC-finalized observation
timestamp.  It is deliberately not mislabeled as a ShredStream/gRPC receive
clock.  Likewise, no submitted exit exists in research-only mode, so the
gate reports post-deadline market observations as context only.

Audit Pump-curve economics against the causal tape without changing policy.

This audit isolates two execution-parity questions:
1. Does the reserve state change between the observed wallet buy and the
   one-second delayed entry?
2. How much does the current anchor-state quote differ from a conservative
   tape-derived pre-entry state quote?

It does not claim receive-clock or transaction-inclusion parity. It is a
read-only diagnostic for the existing prospective cohort.

Read-only native-order Pump-curve timing and exit-inclusion audit.

This is a versioned repair of the earlier parity diagnostic.  It does not
change the frozen policy, the collectors, or any execution path.

The repair has three important properties:

* Same-slot market transactions are ordered by the finalized transactionIndex
  carried in the raw transaction, not by signature text.
* Entry is quoted from the state at the one-second block-time boundary.  When
  transactions exist in the boundary second, the tape cannot tell whether the
  receive-side delay elapsed before or after them, so both boundary states are
  retained instead of choosing one silently.
* Exit marks are separated into the state immediately before the exit
  boundary, states after transactions in that boundary second, and the first
  state in the following second.  These are inclusion candidates, not claims
  that a sell was submitted or included.

The resulting report is an audit artifact only.  It is intentionally unable
to certify receive-clock parity without native arrival and submitted-transaction
telemetry.
Audit exact-ledger admission coverage without using outcome information.
Fail-closed pre-N3000 audit and immutable pipeline freeze manifest.
Cross-check every current Mayhem exclusion against immutable finalized evidence.
Cross-check non-SOL Pump transitions against immutable finalized evidence.

Independently classify PumpSwap buys rejected by the strict validator.

The normal PumpSwap validator remains fail-closed.  This audit only proves
whether rejected records contain a matching successful wallet BUY and which
invariant still prevents economics admission.
Stream Ranker N25 JSONL and report lifecycle/ownership anomalies.
Outcome-blind reliability audit for the fixed post-coverage 2CQ window.
Compare transaction shape for exact-ledger hits versus finalized-success misses.
Fail-closed audit for the new-wallet causal discovery snapshot.
Outcome-blind, bounded canonical coverage check for the full-meta lane.

Derive an outcome-blind 2CQ structural fingerprint from preserved evidence.

This file deliberately does not read PnL, exits, controls, or market outcomes.
It describes what the confirmed wallet actually did: venue/route, quote asset,
curve phase, and order-size/timing distributions.  A separate detector may use
the resulting contract to find structurally similar market-wide buys.

Build a deterministic, non-overlapping same-period control sample.

The independent lab's market-wide windows are already admitted without a
teacher-wallet trigger.  This script creates a separate control tape from the
same windows, pairing nearby observations in the same UTC five-minute bucket
and route.  Pairing uses only signal time, route, mint, and signature; it does
not inspect PnL, exits, or any future outcome.

The controls are a contemporaneous market baseline, not a causal treatment
control.  They are sufficient for discovery diagnostics, but promotion remains
blocked until native state and prospective validation gates pass.

Build an outcome-blind route census from KEFI wallet transactions only.

This intentionally ignores legacy candidate_arm_ids.  Those labels came from
the mixed 13-arm registry and include 2CQ-derived populations.  Route identity
is reconstructed from the finalized transaction's invoked programs, exact
underlying-venue resolution, and exact wallet-side transitions where an
adapter can prove them.

The result is a census and evidence inventory, not a policy selector.  It does
not compute PnL, freeze a policy, start a cohort, or touch any collector.
Derive a KEFI-only route registry from the immutable route census.
Build the single pre-registered, research-only KEFI strategy contract.
Build the immutable, discovery-only exact-alpha research table.

Capture the canonical Pump fee-config account as separate read-only evidence.

Fee configuration is protocol state, not native transaction timing. This tool
therefore writes an explicitly non-causal configuration snapshot and never
labels it as a native receive-time observation.

Record receive-only exit intents without submitting transactions.

This is deliberately not submitted-exit telemetry.  It is the bridge between
the frozen paper policy and the future executor receipt schema.  Every row
states explicitly that no transaction was submitted or included.

Bounded same-slot PumpSwap controls for the confirmed 2CQ wallet.

This is receive-only research capture. It fetches a finalized block only for
an exact tracked-wallet PumpSwap buy, retains exact PumpSwap controls from the
same slot up to a fixed cap, and never emits a venue guess for other rows.
Receive-only finalized RPC source for an explicitly named wallet.
Deduplicated pool-transaction windows for exact wallet anchors.

Deduplicated finalized block windows after wallet anchors.

This is receive-only research capture.  It records complete finalized blocks
once per slot and maps each wallet anchor to the blocks covering the explicit
one-second entry delay through the 300-second maximum exit horizon.

Receive-only same-slot causal tape for the confirmed 2CQ wallet.

The wallet source remains the authoritative anchor stream.  This collector
adds contemporaneous successful transactions from each anchor's finalized
slot, preserving raw transaction lineage and route-resolution status.  It is
not an evaluator and never selects a policy or submits a transaction.

Capture finalized causal market windows for exact Pump bonding-curve buys.

This lane is deliberately separate from PumpSwap.  A wallet BUY is admitted
only from the exact Pump TradeEvent decoder.  Post-entry market transactions
are collected by mint, then decoded later by the venue-native evaluator.

Capture native Raydium CLMM causal windows for exact wallet buys.

Pump-program transactions are explicitly excluded even when they contain
Raydium accounts: the Pump curve adapter owns those transitions.
Outcome-blind classification of deferred 2CQ symmetric observations.
Classify missing 2CQ exact-ledger signatures without reading trade outcomes.
Delete only the archived, rebuildable exact-ledger Cargo target directory.

Read-only comparison of the preserved ARM07 PumpSwap cohorts.

The command consumes sealed report files and their explicitly supplied tape
snapshots.  It never changes a cohort, policy, registry, collector, or
evaluator.  The report replays the selected observation IDs with the current
evaluator and then compares entry-state, fee, reserve, path, and control
features between cohorts.

Compare Pump-curve parity timing with the original economics formula.

This is read-only.  It deliberately keeps the original quote functions,
fee inputs, notional, network fee, and post-state exit valuation.  Only event
ordering and the entry-state timing are varied, so the result can identify
whether a PnL change came from formula changes or timing/order changes.
Remove only verified overlap from a new outcome-blind observation batch.

Summarize unknown invoked programs from an immutable finalized RPC tape.

This is deliberately diagnostic only. It does not assign a venue or alter any
route/economics artifact. The output preserves enough instruction/log/account
shape to decide whether a decoder can be admitted later.

Emit one fresh non-teacher market candidate for executor calibration.

This is a calibration adapter, not a strategy selector.  It consumes the
independent native Pump-state stream, requires a fresh clean observation, and
emits at most one candidate.  It never signs or submits anything itself.

Receive-only native Pump curve state enrichment.

The native ShredStream observation already contains the causal receive clock
and transaction identity.  This bridge adds exact finalized Pump TradeEvent
state by signature.  It never changes the original observation and never
submits a transaction.  RPC is deliberately kept in this research bridge,
outside the execution hot path.

Evaluate frozen ARM07 entries against later exact PumpSwap state marks.

This is an economics-stage consumer.  It runs only after the observation
partition has passed the fresh-cohort audit, uses the frozen 30-second policy,
and never changes selection or policy.  Controls are intentionally explicit:
until same-venue controls are supplied, the report cannot pass promotion.

Read-only Pump curve parity-v2 replay with timing and exit bounds.

Ambiguous finalized-second ordering is retained as an interval. No row is
silently dropped or assigned a false exact entry state. This is diagnostic;
it does not change the frozen policy or enable execution.
Evaluate one preregistered Pump top-level policy on a fresh cohort.
Conservative N=10k operational gate for exact-evidence alpha discovery.

Causal PumpSwap economics surface over wallet anchors and post-entry windows.

Only exact PumpSwap buy transitions are currently economically eligible. Other
routes are retained as explicit unsupported/coverage outcomes; they are never
silently converted into prices.
Emit the explicit Meteora DLMM no-admission economics surface.

Causal, venue-native Pump bonding-curve economics surface.

This evaluator consumes only Pump-curve window records.  It uses the exact
integer curve evaluator, a one-second entry delay, realized fee fields from
the anchor/mark events, explicit missed exits, and separate SOL notionals.
It never imports PumpSwap, Raydium, or Meteora pricing logic.

Emit a venue-separated Raydium CLMM economics surface.

The current CLMM adapter proves exact transitions and post-swap price state,
but it does not have the pre-entry tick-array/liquidity snapshot needed to
quote a hypothetical 0.1/0.5/1.0 SOL order after the one-second delay.  This
script therefore emits explicit blocked surface rows rather than inventing
PnL from an observed trade size.
Analyze the preregistered EVENT_FLOW_COMPETING_RISK_V1 rows.
Build exact causal event-state rows for EVENT_FLOW_COMPETING_RISK_V1.
Evidence coverage census and fixed-cohort exact economic bridge.

Fail-closed, rate-limited archival for cold immutable evidence trees.

Copies one source tree to an NFS staging area, hashes every regular file on
both sides, atomically publishes only a complete match, and never removes the
local source.  A separate release gate must consume the receipt.

Separate, fail-closed local release gate for a verified cold archive.

The default mode only writes a preflight receipt.  ``--release`` additionally
replaces the local immutable source with a symlink to the verified NFS object.
It never acts without an archive receipt and a zero-reference preflight.

Versioned Mayhem extension for validated Pump exact-curve economics V1.

This module deliberately leaves exactCurveEconomicsV1.py unchanged. It proves
that a finalized Mayhem TradeEvent is economically replayable only when its
SOL and quote reserve views agree and the existing integer transition model
reproduces the finalized event exactly.

Exact quote-native Pump economics extension for non-SOL CreateV2 markets.

The validated V1 evaluator remains SOL-only. This extension validates finalized
non-SOL TradeEvent transitions in their native quote units and refuses to
normalize results to SOL without causal conversion evidence.

Exact Pump bonding-curve economics and live Ranker replay.

This evaluator deliberately has no market-cap-ratio fallback. A result is
produced only from finalized transaction status, Pump TradeEvent reserve
states, decoded instruction constraints, and integer curve/fee arithmetic.

Independent red-team audit for EXACT_CURVE_ECONOMICS_V1.

This program deliberately does not import the production evaluator or its
relabel driver.  It decodes finalized transaction evidence, implements the
published Pump arithmetic independently, and recomputes aggregate and
coverage claims from row-level artifacts.
Run the frozen, descriptive executable-opportunity census over discovery mints.
Execute the exact, pre-audited EdgeSniffer deletion manifest.
Extract an immutable slot window from the fixed-record AllenHark journal.

Create a receive-only teacher-matched view without rewriting the raw feed.

The ShredStream source intentionally contains broad Pump flow context.  This
filter keeps only observations explicitly labeled as matching the configured
teacher wallet, preserving the broad source and its byte cursor unchanged.

Perform the final paper-stage review for the canonical 13-arm ranking.

This review does not submit transactions and does not authorize live sizing.
It separates an evaluated-arm OOS winner from a global 13-arm winner when
other arms have no comparable fresh cohort.
Finalize the bounded evidence census from already materialized row facts.
Integrity-audit and finalize the immutable executable-opportunity census.
Combine the completed 2CQ development-only decomposition reports.

Append outcome-blind observations to the canonical 13-arm partitions.

The collector boundary is intentionally strict.  It accepts only rows whose
arm, venue, decoder/evaluator status, frozen policy, and registry/policy hashes
match the sealed collection manifest.  It rejects outcome/economics fields so
the prospective selection cohort cannot be contaminated by its own results.
Read decompressed PEL1 frames from stdin and emit a compact integrity summary.
Read-only summary of unresolved causal anchor rows.

Join route-candidate native receipts to finalized tracked-wallet records.

The native observer cannot resolve address-table wallet membership without RPC.
It therefore records route-candidate receipt clocks; this read-only join waits
for the finalized wallet source to identify the tracked wallet and joins by
exact signature. No timing field is synthesized.

Receive-only finalized transaction source for the canonical 13-arm program.

This is a research capture lane, not an execution dependency.  It polls the
canonical venue program addresses at finalized commitment, writes append-only
raw transaction evidence, and never assigns PnL, selects a policy, or submits
transactions.  Arm assignment remains a separate exact materialization step.

Receive-only finalized PumpSwap tape collector for frozen-arm evaluation.

Pools are discovered from the wallet-scoped canonical source.  This collector
then records exact PumpSwap transitions for those same pools, including
non-teacher trades needed for matched controls and later marks.  It never
computes PnL and never submits transactions.
Synthesize outcome-blind candidate-specific kEFi context results.

Outcome-blind descriptive entry-structure analysis for the frozen kEFi sample.

This deliberately does not read outcomes, PnL, labels, or fit a predictive model.
It joins the sealed structural trade rows to their sealed pre-entry context rows and
emits reproducible descriptive archetypes for offline research.

Outcome-blind structural synthesis from exact kEFi PumpSwap entry state.

This consumes only the frozen BUY sample, exact decoded entry events, and
structural metadata. It does not read outcomes, PnL, labels, or fit a model.

Summarize exact PumpSwap event/state fields from candidate-context output.

Descriptive, outcome-blind research only. This consumes the bounded Rust
extractor output and never reads outcomes, PnL, or live service state.
Build an outcome-blind paper shadow from the frozen kEFi entry envelope.
Outcome-blind comparison of historical and fresh exact kEFi BUY structure.

Receive-only native route-causal PumpSwap tape for KEFI research.

This is deliberately separate from the existing PumpSwap tape collector.  The
existing tape is preserved and remains the source of historical evidence.  This
collector adds the missing route provenance for every exact PumpSwap transition,
including non-KEFI contemporaneous controls:

* direct top-level PumpSwap versus PumpSwap invoked through a router/CPI;
* the exact transaction and decoder lineage for each transition;
* pre/post pool state, fees, and durable source sequencing;
* tracked-wallet and non-tracked control rows in the same native stream.

It never assigns PnL, selects a policy, submits transactions, or changes an
existing collector.  It is intended to run as a separate receive-only service.
One-shot evaluator for the separately preregistered kEfi H2 base score.
Freeze the next independent kEfi pre-entry paper hypothesis before capture.

Low-impact runner for queue-driven kEfi canonical ingestion.

It has no scientific selection logic.  It runs only while capture is fresh,
and delegates all work to the descriptor-driven ingester so it never scans
the historical receipt tree during a normal cycle.

Materialize sealed capture-first windows into a verified control-read surface.

This is deliberately outcome-blind. It never scores, fits, or evaluates the
fingerprint; it verifies and decodes only windows that the collector already
sealed with a COMPLETE promotion receipt.

Drain a small number of sealed kEfi control windows without competing with capture.

Systemd supplies the low CPU and idle-I/O limits.  This runner keeps the
scientific safety gate at every serial window boundary: a stale or interrupted
source ends the cycle before another control window is decoded.
Low-impact materializer for a fresh, bounded kEfi paper replication.
Low-impact materializer for a fresh, bounded kEfi paper replication.

Audit a sealed kEFi paper result for concentration and reconstruction bias.

This tool never changes the entry rule or reruns model selection. It joins the
sealed paper records to their frozen opportunity identities and reports whether
the observed result is broad across source partitions and mints.

Create outcome-blind paper opportunities from the frozen kEFi rule.

This adapter consumes a frozen, deduplicated capture-first market tape.  It
reproduces the already-frozen pre-entry fingerprint and crowded-impulse rule
without reading any post-entry outcome.  A separate strict replay owns all
economic calculations.

Fail-closed cohort admission guard for future kEfi scientific boundaries.

The guard is intentionally small and outcome-blind.  It verifies the epoch
registry first, then checks every candidate timestamp against the frozen
boundary and registry status.  It is designed to be called by a future
materializer/research-table publisher; it does not create a cohort itself.

Freeze a reference-only catalog for repeatable kEfi hypothesis research.

This tool never decodes source frames, fetches outcomes, or copies the market
tape.  It proves that a materialized market snapshot and its per-window
receipts are intact, then publishes a small immutable catalog that subsequent
hypotheses can reference by hash.  New rules therefore reuse the same sealed
evidence instead of starting another raw capture lane.

One-shot, pre-registered kEfi replication evaluator.

It remains outcome-blind until the fresh source has produced the declared
minimum of six materialized source partitions and 8,000 frozen-rule matches.
Once that gate is met it runs the existing strict economics replay exactly
twice, requires byte-identical output, writes the concentration audit, and
leaves the result PENDING_REVIEW. It never enables execution.
Create a fresh kEfi paper boundary only after a clean live source gate.
One-shot outcome-blind evaluation of sealed kEFi selection snapshots.
Fail closed before the kEfi full-meta lane exhausts or loses hot storage.

Whole-window, outcome-blind pre-H3 mechanics certification.

This is an engineering gate only.  It neither selects an H3 hypothesis nor
opens a cohort.  It proves that every materialized PumpSwap row has a stable
source order and is either mechanically tradeable or explicitly rejected.

Exact, fail-closed mechanics primitives for a future kEfi H3 paper lane.

This module is not an H3 strategy and never opens a cohort.  It only defines
the evidence rules a reviewed H3 protocol must use: writer-sequence ordering,
canonical SOL-quote PumpSwap layouts, delayed entry state, observed exit mark,
deterministic controls, and dependence clusters.  It intentionally refuses to
invent hypothetical fills from BPS fields.

Crash-recoverable, queue-driven canonical kEfi event ingestion.

Normal operation consumes only descriptors published by the materializer after
its receipt is durable.  Historical receipts are never globbed or re-hashed on
the hot path.  A descriptor is claimed atomically, its receipt and rows are
verified once, and SQLite commits the event plus exposure mapping together.
After a crash, an item left in ``processing`` is safely replayed: the existing
window binding must match byte-for-byte or ingestion fails closed.

One-shot evaluator for the frozen kEfi 40/20 selection split.

Writes a durable OPENED marker before reading a single holdout snapshot.  A
marker without a result is intentionally fail-closed and cannot be retried.

Frozen-split, outcome-blind initial kEfi token-selection audit.

The development stage reads only the split's first forty snapshot files.  It
cannot access the listed holdout paths.  It verifies source hashes before
parsing and produces a machine-readable development audit only.

Frozen outcome-blind evaluator for PRE_H3_ACTIONABILITY_QUALIFICATION_V1.

Input assignments must already have been produced by the strict cohort and
control matcher.  This script cannot create a cohort or select controls; it
only evaluates the frozen all-target and paired populations.

Deterministically build PRE_H3_ACTIONABILITY_QUALIFICATION_V1 assignments.

This is deliberately an upstream publisher, not an evaluator or boundary
creator.  It admits all frozen-fingerprint matches before delayed entry,
tradeability, or horizon availability is derived; binds every input and tool
identity; and writes the JSONL consumed by the frozen evaluator.
Outcome-blind duplicate provenance audit for a void qualification cohort.

Create the one immutable PRE_H3_ACTIONABILITY_QUALIFICATION_V1 boundary.

The command deliberately has no evaluator path.  It only freezes the launch
contract, records the source baseline, and opens one FUTURE_UNOPENED epoch.

Low-impact, outcome-sealed consumer for PRE_H3_ACTIONABILITY_QUALIFICATION_V1.

It only materializes fully post-boundary sealed windows.  A source hard wall is
durably recorded once and the cohort never resumes.  Representation readiness
reads identities/control coverage only; the frozen evaluator is invoked once,
after those gates pass.

One-shot, isolated proof that post-repair live windows meet H3 mechanics.

It polls only manifests until one fully post-restart promoted window exists,
then materializes that *engineering sandbox* through the mandatory scientific
guard and restart-safe index.  It never creates an H3 record, boundary, or
result, and it leaves the active capture service untouched.

Freeze the non-negotiable mechanics contract for future kEfi paper replay.

This is deliberately a contract, not a strategy evaluator.  It makes two
requirements explicit before any H3 paper result can exist: source-order must
be deterministic at equal receipt timestamps, and PumpSwap execution must be
reconstructed from raw instruction/event transitions rather than approximate
fee-BPS arithmetic.
Append-only hash-chained registry for kEfi scientific evidence epochs.

Fail-closed launcher for a future kEfi scientific materialization cohort.

This is intentionally not enabled and cannot create a cohort.  When an
independently reviewed H3 boundary eventually exists, this runner is the only
supported materialization entrypoint: it supplies the epoch registry/boundary
and asks the materializer to require deterministic source order.

Outcome-blind temporal/actionability audit for sealed kEfi market rows.

This does not discover or score a strategy.  It proves whether a later paper
entry simulator has the ordering fields needed to avoid using an event before
it was visible to the source.  Any ambiguous identity, missing timing/fee
field, or conflicting duplicate is recorded as a fail-closed defect.
Finalize and normalize the prospective AllenHark LaunchLab evidence tape.

Exact, fail-closed Raydium LaunchLab trade-event economics.

The canonical LaunchLab TradeEvent is authoritative for curve reserve
transitions. Wallet token-balance deltas remain authoritative for inventory,
because Token-2022 transfer fees can make received inventory smaller than the
curve's amount_out.
Print compact, read-only integrity diagnostics for the LaunchLab ledger.
Run frozen blind executable baselines at causal lifecycle anchors.

Materialize an independent event-driven 2CQ fingerprint lane.

The older independent lane admitted an early Pump-curve buy and only then
tested broad continuation filters.  This lane keeps the raw evidence intact
and instead reconstructs the short burst immediately before the candidate
buy.  It is discovery-only: it does not use the teacher wallet as an
admission condition, select a policy, or enable execution.

Detect the frozen structural 2CQ fingerprint in a market-wide native tape.

The detector never uses the teacher wallet as an admission condition.  It uses
only the fingerprint contract plus native rows available in the stream.  It
keeps the causal receipt timestamp, applies a fixed +1,000 ms entry boundary,
and emits explicit failures when state or fee fields are missing.

Join exact frozen-scorer events to native causal Pump windows.

This is deliberately separate from signal scoring.  The scorer decides which
native event crossed the preserved threshold; this module only reconstructs
what was available one second later and attaches native marks.  It never uses
the teacher label to admit a signal and it emits controls from the same tape.

Materialize exact Pump launch lineage for the preserved native scorer.

The native trade stream contains the causal trade state but not necessarily the
CREATE transaction.  This bridge joins an exact CREATE registry to an optional
